answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 156838 Country: India Title: Can bank interest be used in free public welfare work? Question: (1) Can bank interest money be given to a poor Muslim? (2) I am planning to buy an ambulance for public welfare. Can I use bank interest money with the money I have kept for buying ambulance for poor & needy? Please guide me. Answer ID: 156838 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 390/312/B=3/1439) (1) Yes, you may give him. (2) It is not lawful to include interest amount in the amount which you have saved for buying ambulance. It is not lawful to spend interest money for public welfare. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
